speaker: Teacher (śeṣavartana charter)
question: What follows initiation?
premises: yā dīkṣā saṃskārasiddhyai jñānayogyān prati — initiation for refinement-perfection, for the knowledge-fit.
yā ca tadaśaktān prati mokṣadīkṣā sabījā — and with-seed release-initiation for the incapable.
tasyāṃ kṛtāyām ājīvaṃ śeṣavartanaṃ guruḥ upadiśet — once performed, the guru teaches the lifelong remainder.
inference: Charter: two initiations (knowledge-fit vs incapable) → lifelong course taught by guru.

speaker: Teacher (threefold remainder)
question: How is the remainder divided?
premises: tatra nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyam iti trividhaṃ śeṣavartanam — daily, occasional, desired-for.
antyaṃ ca sādhakasyaiva — the last for the practitioner alone.
tat na iha niścetavyam — not decided here.
inference: Threefold remainder; desired-for rite deferred (practitioner-only, out of scope).

speaker: Teacher (daily vs occasional)
question: What is daily, what occasional?
premises: tatra niyatabhavaṃ nityaṃ — the regularly occurring is daily.
tanmayībhāva eva naimittikaṃ — identity-with-that alone is occasional.
tadupayogi saṃdhyopāsanaṃ pratyaham anuṣṭhānaṃ parvadinaṃ pavitrakam ityādi — serving it: twilight worship, daily practice, festival day, sacred thread.
inference: Daily = recurrent; occasional = identity; servants listed.

speaker: Some (ke-cit view)
question: Is even that daily?
premises: tad api nityaṃ svakālanaiyatyāt — that too is daily, by fixedness of its own time.
iti kecit — say some.
inference: Minority view: fixed-time occasional counts as daily.

speaker: Some (occasional irregularity)
question: When is the occasional irregular?
premises: naimittikaṃ tu tacchāsanasthānām api aniyatam — occasional even for his abiders is irregular.
tadyathā gurutadvargāgamanaṃ tatparvadinaṃ jñānalābhadinam ityādikam — e.g. guru's circle coming, their festival, knowledge-day.
iti kecit.
inference: Occasion list; irregularity even for insiders.

speaker: Teacher (unfailing set)
question: What never lapses?
premises: tatra niyatapūjā saṃdhyopāsā gurupūjā parvapūjā pavitrakam iti avaśyaṃbhāvi — fixed, twilight, guru, festival worship, sacred thread: unfailing.
inference: The unfailing five.

speaker: Teacher (occasion catalogue)
question: What triggers special worship?
premises: naimittikam jñānalābhaḥ śāstralābho ... samayaniṣkṛtilābhaḥ — knowledge-gain through rule-expiation-gain.
ity etat naimittikaṃ viśeṣārcanakāraṇam — this occasional causes special worship.
inference: Twelve occasions catalogued; special worship their fruit.

speaker: Teacher (mantra transmission)
question: How is the chief mantra given?
premises: kṛtadīkṣākasya śiṣyasya pradhānaṃ mantraṃ savīryakaṃ saṃvittisphuraṇasāram alikhitaṃ vaktrāgamenaiva arpayet — unwritten, power-holding mantra transmitted by mouth-lineage alone.
tanmayībhāvasiddhyarthaṃ ... saṃdhyāsu tanmayībhāvābhyāsaṃ kuryāt — practice identity at twilights.
taddvāreṇa sarvakālaṃ ... pratyahaṃ ca parameśvaraṃ ca sthaṇḍile vā liṅge vā abhyarcayet — through that, always; daily worship the Lord on altar or liṅga.
inference: Unwritten mouth-transmission; twilight identity-practice; daily altar/liṅga worship.

speaker: Teacher (mirror rite)
question: How is identity contemplated?
premises: hṛdye sthaṇḍile vimalamakuravad dhyāte — on the heart-altar meditated as stainless mirror.
svam eva rūpaṃ yājyadevatācakrābhinnaṃ mūrtibimbitam iva dṛṣṭvā — seeing own form non-different from the deity-wheel, body-reflected.
hṛdyapuṣpagandhāsavatarpaṇanaivedyadhūpadīpopahārastutigītavādyanṛttādinā pūjayet japet stuvīta — worship with the full offering train; murmur; praise.
tanmayībhāvam aśaṅkitaṃ labdhum — to gain doubt-free identity.
inference: Mirror-contemplation of own form as deity-wheel; full offerings; doubt-free identity.

speaker: Teacher (mirror reason)

na cātra kaścit kramaḥ pradhānam ṛte tanmayībhāvāt — no order here is chief apart from identity.
inference: Swiftness without order; identity alone chief.

speaker: Our gurus (heart doctrine)

premises: paramantrat...raśajālasya — entered into supreme-mantra identity, stain gone, bond-net melted.

inference: Guru saying: the indwelling heart is the highest take-up.

speaker: Verse (flash)

speaker: Stotra verse (ground rite)

inference: Wonder-sprinkled ground; mental flowers.
uncertainties: kṛtvādhāradharāṃ junction obscure; rite-sense from stotra frame.
